name: sitesplat/gyazo
description: Gyazo - forum images uploader allows the upload of forum images via the image host service GYAZO - Please note, You will need to register an Gyazo app to get the Access Token needed for this extension to work. For creating a new App go to https://gyazo.com/api and register it following the instruction provided. Use the Access Token under ACP > Postings > Attachment settings: Gyazo Access Token
